note: Internal normalized contract. This is not a claim about any raw broker export format.

replay_policy.stop_ack_semantics: ACK activates a requested stop only while the trade remains open
replay_policy.closed_trade_semantics: active stop is cleared when open volume reaches zero

normalization_rules: time_us is UTC microseconds after explicit source clock mapping
source_seq is globally unique and strictly follows source chronology after normalization
event_id and locator are unique within one normalized source bundle
trade_id is never reopened after its open volume reaches zero
request_id and commitment_id are never reused within a replay
commission_cost_micro and swap_cost_micro are non-negative incurred costs
cash_per_price_unit_micro belongs to EXIT_FILL and is the explicit account-currency conversion used for that realized exit calculation
ENTRY_FILL does not carry a P&L conversion factor in v1
one normalized bundle binds exactly one lowercase raw source SHA-256
